cases.deviation: on SQLite upstream returns DECIMAL as a JS number (9.99); the port returns it as a string ("9.99") for precision, matching how Sequelize itself returns DECIMAL on Postgres/MySQL. Upstream's SQLite behaviour is the outlier across its own dialects.
